title: Repeat Deferment Factor on the Home Purchase Financing Deferment Fee
content:
**Loss mitigation committee resolution — repeat deferments on Home Purchase Financing loans**

The deferment fee is the deferment agreement charge times the deferment repeat factor, plus the deferral charge, rounded half up to the cent once on that sum. The repeat factor multiplies the agreement charge only; the deferral charge is added unmultiplied.

Where an earlier deferment agreement was signed on the loan in the 36 whole months before the signing date and two or more installments have already been deferred over the loan's life, the deferment repeat factor is 1.5; where an earlier agreement was signed in those 36 months and fewer than two installments have been deferred over the loan's life, the deferment repeat factor is 1.25. Where no earlier agreement was signed in those 36 months, no repeat factor applies.

| Earlier agreement in the 36 whole months before signing | Installments already deferred over the loan's life | Deferment repeat factor |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 2 or more | 1.5 |
| yes | fewer than 2 | 1.25 |
| no | any | none applies |

The earlier agreements are those recorded on the loan's notices, by their dates; the installments already deferred over the loan's life are shown on the loan record.

*Hypothetical example.* An agreement charge of 50.00 with a deferral charge of 14.10, on a loan with one earlier agreement in the 36 months and 2 installments already deferred: 50.00 times 1.5 is 75.00, plus 14.10, a fee of 89.10. With only 1 installment already deferred: 62.50 plus 14.10, a fee of 76.60.
